disposition_reason: Regulatory risk assessment: tolerable daily intake for hexavalent chromium and water-intake estimates; no food or water concentration data.

study.method: literature and evaluation-report review; benchmark dose modeling

regulatory_or_exposure: TDI for hexavalent chromium 1.1 µg/kg bw/day (BMDL10 0.11 mg/kg bw/day, uncertainty factor 100) (p. 56, p. 57)
Estimated hexavalent chromium intake from mineral and tap water: mean ca. 0.04 µg/kg bw/day; high 0.290 µg/kg bw/day (p. 56, p. 57)
non_numeric_findings: Hexavalent chromium judged carcinogenic in rodents by drinking water (small intestine tumors in mice; oral mucosa and tongue tumors in rats).
Oral genotoxicity of hexavalent chromium unclear; carcinogenic mechanism by drinking water judged hardly attributable to genotoxicity.
Ingested hexavalent chromium is reduced to trivalent chromium slightly by saliva and mainly by gastric juice.
